text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The heated match comes to an end. The
racers
clashed with their separate ways
of running. And
then...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Suzuka...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright's eyes are locked on
Silence Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: You were incredible...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Bright?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Have I seen anyone run like that ever
before?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I don't believe I have... That was
something I... it
was something no Mejiro
is capable of.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: So that was the real you, Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It was, Bright. But I'm still far from
perfect. I still
haven't reached that
scenery...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: But, at the autumn Tenno Sho...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I see... Then that means I shall also have
to polish
myself to a brighter sheen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Just like how the scenery you seek
remains out of
reach...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: The Mejiro's ideal still lies beyond me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Um... Regardless, Suzuka, would you
race against
me once again?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Before, I may have inspired you. But
today, you
were the one who taught me
something.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I'm not done yet. I can still run in a way
that is
more fitting to the Mejiros.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: So... at the autumn Tenno Sho...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yeah. It's a promise.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two speak frankly to one another.
Mutually
motivated, they head toward
the ultimate stage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The autumn Tenno Sho. I feel like
something
special will happen after what
I've seen here
today. To be at our best,
we'll have to train like
never before.
